page.overview:
Who is Admiral Kiefer?

Admiral Kiefer then told the rest of the Fantastic Four that they were avoiding the Atlantic Ridge because it carried the debris from the Sub-Mariner Wars including Human and Atlantean ships along with unlaunched nuclear warheads they had attempted to use against Atlantis.

The conversation was interrupted by an alert that a torpedo was heading there way, but it turned out to be Namor himself. Namor swam right past them and ended up being kidnapped by the submarine of Doctor Doom.
